what: Plan drops probe-health keys from durable `source-env.sh` but leaves generated `/design` wrappers sourcing that file with `CODEX_PRESENT="${CODEX_PRESENT:-false}"` and `CODEX_AVAILABLE="${CODEX_AVAILABLE:-$CODEX_PRESENT}"`
scenario_or_breakage: After Step 0, `design-step2b-drafter.sh`, `design-step-validator-autofix.sh`, and `review-design-step3-loop.sh` see `CODEX_PRESENT=false` even when `CODEX_BINARY_FOUND=true`, so Codex drafter selection, plan auto-fix, and `plan revise-waterfall` skip external vendors while binaries exist
suggested_fix: Add explicit plan steps to rebind vendor attempt flags from `CODEX_BINARY_FOUND`/`CURSOR_BINARY_FOUND` in wrapper boilerplate and in `design-step2b-drafter.sh`, `design-step-validator-autofix.sh`, and `review-design-step3-loop.sh` (or a shared rehydration helper), and update `skills/design/references/decompose-panel.md` binding text away from Step 0 probe health
